reference: 5x6 periodic P3 cells over [0,2.5] x [0,1.5]. For each velocity compare modal energy against 5x5 point Gauss integration of u²/2 and directional upwind losses against independent Gauss integration of u times the DG spatial operator. An additional analytic jump test uses a uniform background of 2^60 with unit x slope and double y slope, giving losses 6 and 32.
command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m pytest -q tests/test_advection_2d.py tests/test_advection_3d.py tests/test_runge_kutta_orders.py -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml=/tmp/dg2-energy.xml
